title: VSift search JSON Lines terminal data v1
description: The data member of the complete or partial terminal result that ends a search --events jsonl stream. It is the page of search-data.schema.json without its items: the matching segments were the preceding evidence events (record_type transcript_segment, the same records transcript.get streams), in rank order, and record_count says how many there were. hits names each streamed segment and how it matched, in stream order. Pass next_cursor back with the same session, query, range and revision to stream the next page; null means the search is exhausted.

screen_text.description: Since 0.3.0 (ADR 0030), on a first page only: the query's occurrences in on-screen text read by ocr, with each hit's frame, time and region, and how much of the searched range's plan is read. Absent on a page a cursor continues and from releases before 0.3.0. It never changes the envelope's status or coverage.
